question: ____ of the Indian Constitution mentions about office of Speaker of the House of the People.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 93**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Article 93​**

 
 
• Article 93 deals with the appointment of the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker.
 
• The term length of the deputy speaker of the Lok Sabha is five years during the term of the Lok Sabha.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 90:

 
 
• Vacation and resignation of, and removal from, the office of Deputy Chairman.
 
 
 
• Article 92
 
 
• Article 92 of the Indian Constitution deals with the provisions for the Chairman or Deputy Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
 
 

 
• Article 91

 
 
• Article 91 of the Indian Constitution deals with the temporary Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha).
 
• It states that while the office of the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is vacant, or during any period when the Vice-President is acting as or discharging the functions of the President, the duties of the office shall be performed by the Deputy Chairman or, if the office of Deputy Chairman is also vacant, by such member of the Rajya Sabha as the President may appoint for the purpose.
